prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling subway platform. On the far left stands a man in a red scarf, leaning casually against a tiled pillar while holding a folded newspaper. Next to him sits a worn leather suitcase, its handle slightly frayed from use. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow coat points toward the tunnel entrance, her gesture urgent and clear. Beside her, a child in blue overalls looks at the departing train with wide eyes, clutching a small toy robot. A brown dog on a leash sits patiently next to the child, its ears perked up by the noise. To the right, an elderly man in a gray hat sits on a metal bench, reading a thick hardcover book. Standing directly behind the bench is a teenager with headphones, tapping their foot to an unheard rhythm. Near the edge of the platform, a businesswoman in a black suit checks her wristwatch, appearing impatient. A stray pigeon pecks at crumbs near her polished shoes, oblivious to the crowd. Above them all, a flickering fluorescent light buzzes softly, casting faint shadows. There is no digital signage displaying arrival times. There is no visible track maintenance crew working in the background. The composition balances the static figures with the implied motion of the train, creating a moment of suspended activity within the underground space.
